title: Systematic Fx app with ML models, fundamental/technical outlook, set-up, xauusd bot, what you think?
author: Humble_Research_708
selftext:
Every production prediction made by the platform is stored before the outcome is known and later evaluated against the realised market move.

Nothing is removed afterward.

The public performance page separates:

* all published predictions,
* non-overlapping independent evaluation episodes,
* correct / incorrect / pending outcomes,
* realised forecast pips.

In fewer than 15 live market sessions so far, the production set has generated **265+ published predictions**, roughly **500+ realised pips across the independent non-overlapping sample**, with overall production accuracy currently around **63%**.

Obviously, that is still a relatively small live sample and I’m not presenting it as proof of a permanent edge. The entire reason for keeping the ledger public is to let the live sample grow without rewriting history later.

The platform currently includes models such as **GBPUSD 12h, EURUSD 3h and EURUSD 6h**, alongside a broader macro/fundamental outlook.

Alongside the models, subscribers get access to our Technical & Fundamental Outlook, covering:  
• market regime  
• USD / EUR / GBP / JPY outlook  
• Treasury yields and macro drivers  
• key economic events  
• technical structure  
• base scenario  
• alternative scenario  
• invalidation levels

The outlook is not generated as a generic AI summary. It is structured around things such as monetary policy, Treasury yields, inflation/labour data, cross-asset behaviour, market regime, technical structure, base scenarios and invalidation.

My best model for now:

EURUSD 3H independent accuracy: 66.7%  
EURUSD 3H all published accuracy: 61.9%

I also built a separate **XAUUSD Structural Gold Bot**.

That bot is currently a **public live-shadow / paper system**, not a live-money execution account. Every paper trade, including losing trades, remains visible together with equity, drawdown, P/L and the trade ledger.

I made that section completely free because I would rather let people watch the system develop over time than publish another backtest and ask them to believe it.

I’m currently onboarding a final group of users this week before pausing onboarding and focusing on live validation and further development.

soo, what do you think? i want to hear everyone who is interested in convo..
